bibl.title: Domestic Comedy and the Classical Greek House.
bibl.seg: Matthew Wright, Domestic Comedy and the Classical Greek House.
bibl.note: Argues that descriptions of domestic interiors in Greek (New) Comedy constitute a valuable and overlooked source of evidence for historians of the classical Greek house, with a key scene from Menander's Samia (225-241) as the most detailed example.
